item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong 2024 evidence of a Modi-led precaution/transparency framework specifically for cyber, AI, or biological risk.\nI found no direct evidence of public red-teaming, independent oversight, or open catastrophic-risk reporting for those domains.\nSo the best-supported conclusion is: precaution is visible in dual-use and nuclear-safety administration, but evidence is thin for AI/cyber/bio-specific transparency.","evidence":[{"title":"DGFT to discuss trade regime of dual-use goods, software and technology on Jan 30","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / DGFT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry","date":"28 Jan 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2000179","summary":"The government convened a strategic trade-controls conference with MEA and other agencies, focused on SCOMET compliance and dual-use controls, with UN 1540 and MTCR participation. This is strong evidence of precautionary institutional handling of dual-use risk and some transparency about the control framework.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.6","1B.7"]},{"title":"DGFT updates the SCOMET List with recent policy changes and updates in the multilateral export control regimes","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / DGFT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry","date":"3 Sep 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2051331&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"India updated its strategic trade-control list, aligned it with multilateral regimes, and stated that it regulates dual-use, nuclear-related, and military items using licensing, enforcement, and risk assessment mechanisms. This supports a finding of precaution over improvisation in dual-use domains.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.6","1B.7"]},{"title":"AERB Grants Permission for First Approach to Criticality of 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor","publisher":"Atomic Energy Regulatory Board / PIB","date":"30 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2039099&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"AERB approved first criticality only after phased core loading, multi-tier safety review, site inspection, and resident-site-observer oversight. This is direct evidence of precaution, institutional scrutiny, and accident-prevention discipline in a catastrophic-risk domain.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"AERB Grants Permission for First Approach to Criticality of Rajasthan Atomic Power Project - Unit 7","publisher":"Atomic Energy Regulatory Board / PIB","date":"10 Sep 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2053554&lang=1&reg=3","summary":"AERB said approval followed comprehensive safety assessments and continuing oversight by its resident observer team. This is more evidence that the state used technical review and monitoring rather than opaque political decisionmaking.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"US National Security Advisor calls on Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office / PIB","date":"17 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2025954","summary":"The meeting centered on iCET progress in semiconductors, AI, telecom, defence, critical minerals, and space. This is indirect but relevant evidence that Modi’s government treated advanced-technology risk through institutional channels rather than purely ad hoc political handling.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7"]},{"title":"Ministry of Home Affairs: Year End Review 2024","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Home Affairs","date":"31 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2088945&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"The review highlights security apparatus upgrades, including DAE/DRDO-origin explosive detectors being handed to IB and a high-level review of MAC operations. This supports a cautious reading that the government was willing to deploy technical tools and institutional processes in security work.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7"]},{"title":"Shri Amit Shah reassumes charge as Union Home Minister in North Block, New Delhi today","publisher":"Ministry of Home Affairs / PIB","date":"11 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2024244&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"The security portfolio remained centered on Modi and Amit Shah, with strong “zero tolerance” political framing. This is only a weak negative signal: it suggests centralized political control, but it does not show that experts were actually displaced in a catastrophic-risk decision.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7"]}]}
